about: V0 test-phase bug: a JPEG cut off inside its pixel data was accepted as a partly grey photo. The fix is put back out by setup.patch. Policy: fix the code, not the test.
prompt: Bug report: uploading a JPEG that was cut off partway through is accepted and stored as a partly grey photo, when it should be rejected as unreadable. ImageServiceImplTest.truncatedJpegIsRejected fails. Fix it.
